items.title: बिस्तारै, तर निरन्तर
items.message: हिमाल चढ्ने मान्छे एकै फड्कोमा टुप्पोमा पुग्दैन। आज एउटा सानो पाइला मात्र चाल्नुहोस् — त्यही नै प्रगति हो।
items.author: Health Camper

items.title: Mountains teach patience
items.message: The Himalayas were not built in a day. Whatever you're climbing right now, steady steps beat big leaps.
items.author: Health Camper
